title: finding(plugin-hono-server): /auth/me/permissions never seeds an unrestricted object for a wildcard-only principal, so the Console renders Export where the server answers 403 EXPORT_NOT_PERMITTED
body:
**Measured on** `@objectstack/*` 17.4.0 (`console`, `rest`, `plugin-hono-server`, `plugin-security`, `spec`), HotCRM dev server (`objectstack dev -p 4001`, sqlite), 2026-09-18. Sources read on `objectstack` `main@02bdeaaf` and `objectui` `main@6a0d1a43`; the 17.4.0 dist matches at the anchors below.

## Symptom

A post-#8681 platform administrator opens an **unrestricted** object's list. The toolbar renders **Export** (CSV / XLSX); the click answers `403 {"code":"EXPORT_NOT_PERMITTED","error":"Export is not permitted on object 'crm_lead' for this user","object":"crm_lead"}`. On a sibling object that declares `apiMethods`, the same principal sees no Export button at all.

The denial is correct (#3544 / #8681). The affordance is not, and the client cannot know: the channel that is supposed to tell it (`/auth/me/permissions` → `apiOperations`) stays silent for exactly this population.

## Principal

Org owner of the dev tenant, holding no app-authored set. `GET /api/v1/auth/me/permissions` (session) reports:

| field | value |
|---|---|
| `positions` | `["platform_admin","org_owner","everyone"]` |
| `permissionSets` | `["admin_full_access","organization_admin_no_bypass","member_default"]` |
| `objects['*']` | `{allowCreate, allowRead, allowEdit, allowDelete, viewAllRecords, modifyAllRecords: true, allowTransfer: false}` — **no `allowExport`** (#8681, by design) |
| named object keys | `*`, the `sys_*` objects, and 29 `crm_*` objects (all seeded, see below) |

`admin_full_access` names only `*`; `organization_admin_no_bypass` names `*` plus 33 `sys_*`; `member_default` names `sys_*` only. Nothing the principal holds names `crm_lead`.

## Same principal, same session, two objects

| | `crm_account` | `crm_lead` |
|---|---|---|
| `enable` | `{ apiEnabled: true, apiMethods: ['get','list','create','update','delete'] }` | `{ apiEnabled: true }` (unrestricted) |
| entry in `/me/permissions.objects` | present (seeded by `seedSuperUserRestrictedObjects`, folded `true`) | **absent** |
| `apiOperations` | `[get, list, create, update, delete, upsert, aggregate, search, import]` — no `export` | none (no entry) |
| Console list toolbar | no Export button | **Export ▾ (CSV / XLSX) rendered** |
| `GET /api/v1/data/<obj>/export?format=csv` | `403 EXPORT_NOT_PERMITTED` | `403 EXPORT_NOT_PERMITTED` |

Across the app: 38 non-`sys_` objects. The 29 that declare `apiMethods` all get an entry and an `apiOperations` without `export` (button hidden, correct). The 9 unrestricted ones (`crm_campaign_member`, `crm_case`, `crm_contact`, `crm_event`, `crm_event_attendee`, `crm_lead`, `crm_opportunity_line_item`, `crm_quote_line_item`, `crm_task`) get nothing, so the button shows and every click 403s.

## Where

`packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/current-user-endpoints.ts` (main@02bdeaaf), route body 1061-1089:

1. `seedSuperUserRestrictedObjects` (462-474). Line 470 evaluates `resolveEffectiveApiMethods(schema.enable ?? undefined)` **without** `{ userExportAllowed }`, and line 471 skips every `unrestricted` schema ("Unrestricted objects are skipped (they carry no annotation)"). That held on the CRUD axis; on the export axis (#3544) an unrestricted object *does* need an annotation whenever export is withheld.
2. `foldWildcardSuperUser` (1073), `clampManagedObjectWrites` (1074).
3. `annotateEffectiveApiOperations` (487-519). It reads `wildExport = objects['*'].allowExport` (500; `undefined` here), iterates **only existing entries** (501), evaluates *with* `{ userExportAllowed }` (509-511), and its own export-axis branch (512-517: "OR when the export axis removes `export` from an otherwise-open object (so the client hides the Export button)") can only fire for objects that already have an entry. For a wildcard-only principal an unrestricted object never has one, so that branch is unreachable for precisely the population #8681 created, and the comment at 491-499 ("keeps the button the client shows and the request the server accepts in agreement") no longer holds there.

The server side of the contract is consistent: `packages/spec/src/data/api-derivation.ts` `isLegacyDerivable` withholds `export` whenever `!userExportAllowed`; `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts:2278-2295` `enforceExportPermission` → `security.canExport` → 403.

The client renders what it is handed, per #3391 / #3026: `objectui` `packages/permissions/src/MePermissionsProvider.tsx:378-388` `getObjectApiOperations` ("Per-object only — the `*` wildcard carries no apiOperations. Absent → undefined so consumers fall back to their current (default-allow) path"), consumed by `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx:1340-1345` (`schema.allowExport !== false && schema.operations?.export !== false && (effectiveApiOps ? effectiveApiOps.includes('export') : true)`) and `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx:3243-3244, 5097-5098`. The client has no `allowExport` concept of its own and #3391 deliberately keeps derivation server-side, so this is the server's card.

## Options

1. **Seed on the export axis (preferred).** In `seedSuperUserRestrictedObjects`, evaluate with the same input annotate uses — `resolveEffectiveApiMethods(schema.enable ?? undefined, { userExportAllowed: objects['*']?.allowExport === true })` — and stop skipping a schema whose only tightening is the withheld `export`. The fold at 1073 then pulls its CRUD bits `true` exactly as for `apiMethods` objects today, and annotate attaches `apiOperations` without `export`. One guard change; the "harmless for a modify-all caller" argument at 456-459 already covers it. Cost: the map grows by the unrestricted objects (9 here) for such principals.
2. **Cover wildcard principals without `modifyAllRecords`.** A set that reaches an object only via `'*': { allowRead: true }` has the same gap and sits outside the guard at 466. A neutral seed (`objects[name] = {}` / `apiOperations` only, no CRUD bits) keeps the `undefined → default-allow` path the 456-459 comment protects. Follow-up; not required for the population above.
3. **Client-side second signal.** Gate the affordance additionally on `objects[obj]?.allowExport ?? objects['*']?.allowExport === true` in ListView / ObjectGrid. Smallest diff, but it re-derives `canExport` in the client, which #3391 chose not to do.
4. **Record as accepted.** Button shows, click 403s with a self-explaining code. Then narrow the 491-499 comment and #3544's "agreement" claim to objects that already carry an entry.

## Re-check (same principal, after option 1)

- `GET /api/v1/auth/me/permissions` → `.objects.crm_lead.apiOperations` present and without `export`.
- `/_console/apps/<app>/crm_lead` list toolbar hides Export, matching `crm_account` today.
- `GET /api/v1/data/crm_lead/export?format=csv` still `403 EXPORT_NOT_PERMITTED` (unchanged; this card is affordance-only).
- Unit seam: a case beside the existing `seedSuperUserRestrictedObjects` / `annotateEffectiveApiOperations` tests — "modify-all wildcard without `allowExport` + unrestricted schema → entry whose `apiOperations` lacks `export`".

## Not in scope

- Whether this caller should be denied. It should (#8681, ADR-0087). The app's remedy is an app-authored set with `allowExport: true` reached through a position, and staffing that position is the operator's decision.
- The bare `Forbidden` text the Console shows after the click — objectstack-ai/objectui#9594 (dispatched).
- Import affordance gating — #16345.

## Related

#3391, #3026, #3546, #3720 (UI ↔ `apiMethods` contract) · #3544 (export axis) · #8681 / ADR-0087 (admin sets carry no `allowExport`) · `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.admin-export-wildcard-removed.ts` ("Silence is not success") · objectstack-ai/objectui#9594 · #16345.

Reporter: sunhaolin (HotCRM). Measured from the Dev Admin's Console session in a browser pane; no data, grants or app files were changed.
